decision.reason: [ev-e477115a445b] says only that the unused flag `sidecar-istio-proxy-image` has been removed. Because the flag was unused, it did nothing before 1.16 either, so "no longer honoured" (setting-ignored, action-required) overstates the change and is not supported. The evidence also doesn't say what happens if an operator still passes the flag. Cilium might ignore it or refuse to start, so neither "none" nor a failure kind can be settled. The other items in this section [ev-f64f7c540c6d] [ev-0b06499d6851] [ev-b8b62ef806f0] [ev-91fac6720d6f] don't describe what removed flags do at runtime. Deciding this needs upstream text or an artifact showing how cilium-agent and its configuration handle a removed flag that is still set.
